ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower common wire in the circuit is connected to node b. On the left there is a 10 V power supply, whose upper terminal is connected through the left 1 kΩ resistor to the upper-middle node. This upper-middle node is then connected through the right 1 kΩ resistor to node a. Node a is connected through a 2 kΩ resistor to the lower common node b. In the figure, the source S of the N-channel MOSFET is connected to the lower common node b, the drain D is connected to the upper-middle node, and the gate G is connected to the upper terminal of a 2 V power supply, whose lower terminal is also connected to the common node b. Reasoning: Take node b as 0 V. Since the source S is connected to b, V_S = 0 V; the gate is supplied with voltage by the 2 V power supply relative to b, so V_G = 2 V, therefore V_GS = 2 V. The given threshold voltage V_T = +1.0 V, and V_GS > V_T, so the ideal NMOS conducts. When ideally conducting, the drain-source D-S can be equivalent to a short circuit, so the upper-middle node is shorted to b, that is, the voltage of this node is 0 V. At this time node a is connected only through the right 1 kΩ resistor and the 2 kΩ resistor to the 0 V node, and there is no other independent source driving node a, so V_a = V_b = 0 V. Therefore V_ab = V_a - V_b = 0 V.

method.method_draft: Set V_b = 0. From the figure, V_S = 0 and V_G = 2 V, so with the text value V_T = 1.0 V the trial ON condition is satisfied because V_GS = 2 V > 1 V. For an ideal ON MOSFET impose V_D = V_S = 0. Now write KCL at node a using the two resistors connected to zero volts: (V_a - V_D)/1 kΩ + (V_a - V_b)/2 kΩ = 0. Since V_D = V_b = 0, this gives V_a/1 kΩ + V_a/2 kΩ = 0, so V_a = 0. Thus V_ab = V_a - V_b = 0 V, and the assumed ON state remains valid.

图像描述：图中是一个 N 沟道 MOSFET 电路。下方公共导线连接到节点 b；MOSFET 的源极 S 接到这条下方公共导线。栅极 G 由一个标注 2 V 的电源驱动，该电源下端也接到下方公共导线，因此以 b 为参考时栅极电压为 2 V。漏极 D 接到上方中间节点；该节点左侧通过 1 kΩ 电阻接到 10 V 电源，右侧通过 1 kΩ 电阻接到节点 a。节点 a 还通过一个 2 kΩ 电阻接到节点 b，题目要求 V_ab。

推理：按指定方法令 V_b = 0。由图可得 V_S = 0，V_G = 2 V。阈值电压 V_T = 1.0 V，所以 V_GS = V_G - V_S = 2 V > 1.0 V，理想 NMOS 导通条件满足。理想导通时令 V_D = V_S = 0。于是节点 a 通过右侧 1 kΩ 电阻接到 V_D = 0，又通过 2 kΩ 电阻接到 V_b = 0。对节点 a 写 KCL：
(V_a - V_D)/1 kΩ + (V_a - V_b)/2 kΩ = 0。
代入 V_D = 0、V_b = 0，得 V_a/1 kΩ + V_a/2 kΩ = 0，因此 V_a = 0。于是 V_ab = V_a - V_b = 0 - 0 = 0 V。导通假设仍然满足。
